environment.description: Production deployment on ECS Fargate with native_processor.node compiled and available. Split.io SDK configured with API key pointing to Split cloud where 'native-transform-pipeline' flag is set to 'on' for 100% of traffic (default rule: serve 'on'). Container runs as root with no memory protections. Node.js v18.17.0 with --max-old-space-size=4096.

config.native_addon: native_processor.node compiled with gcc -O2, no ASAN
